text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Manuel Fraga, chief of government of Galicia, Spain, ends visit; says fields for possible cooperation include tourism, handicrafts, shipping and agriculture.
- Meetings on Monday and Tuesday to discuss final draft of ninth development plan for 1997-2001.
- Industry Minister Bouguerra encourages chemical industry to modernise.
- President of Tunisia's state-run electricity and gas company STEG says electrification rate to rise to 90 percent by year 2001; STEG celebrates 35th anniversary.
- French fashion designer Pierre Balmain to present annual collection on Saturday; French stars Catherine Deneuve and Gerard Depardieu arrive for event.
- Mediterranean Red Cross and Red Crescent societies pay homage to President Ben Ali for support of humanitarian causes.
